policy: Only this explicitly verified personal-residency subset is structured. All other rows remain unknown; no runtime prose inference. Nationwide means 50 states and DC, not territories. Prior source-check dates and financial terms are unchanged.

entries.geography_scope: personal applicant residence / physical address; not business location
entries.quoted_supporting_evidence: Who can open an account: You must be a United States citizen or lawful permanent resident with a U.S. physical address located in one of the 50 United States or Washington, D.C., or with military addresses (APO or FPO).
entries.evidence_method: Live first-party browser DOM, no login; current campaign also read in live browser.

campaign_evidence.quote: Open a new 360 Performance Savings account with promo code BONUS1500. Review full offer details below.
campaign_evidence.linkage: The live BONUS1500 page links to these full 360 Performance Savings account disclosures and explicitly lists $300/$750/$1,500 deposit tiers.

caveats: Nationwide classification is supported by explicit account-specific 50-state/DC address language, not by online opening or absence of a campaign restriction. The campaign links these account disclosures; nationwide wording is in the account disclosure rather than repeated in bonus terms.
United States citizenship or lawful permanent residency, age 18+, U.S.-based mobile, valid SSN or ITIN, linked U.S.-chartered-bank account and approval restrictions still apply.
APO/FPO addresses are an explicit additional route; the 51-code state list does not model military addresses. No blanket territory eligibility is asserted.
Prior savings-account ownership exclusions and BONUS1500 funding/holding conditions remain independent; offer can change before acceptance.
